text: I prefer to use natural remedies for minor ailments whenever possible — honey for a sore throat, ginger tea for nausea, lavender oil to help me relax before bed. I know these aren't substitutes for real medicine when something serious is going on, and I always see my doctor for anything beyond the basics. But for everyday wellness, I'd rather reach for something that comes from a plant than a pill.
